description: Monitor signal discrimination quality for weak signals (permission_scope, temporal_stability, tool_description_safety). Each has only 4 distinct values across 34 MCP fingerprints — below the 20-distinct-score threshold for valid enrichment. Queries mcp_signal_enrichments table via write_service for each weak signal, computes distinct count and range. Logs warning if any signal remains below 20 distinct values after 7 days. Does not modify any data. Implements graceful degradation per spec section 6. Heartbeat to service_health.
